## TemplateEngine.validateBlockGVenueAttributes() method

Validates attributes and presence rules on `<g-venue>` blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validateBlockGVenueAttributes(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

## Remarks

Checks the block-level attributes (`lang`<!-- -->, `title`<!-- -->, `address`<!-- -->, `latitude`<!-- -->, `longitude`<!-- -->) via `_validateBlockAttributes`<!-- -->, then delegates presence rules (all four venue fields required and non-empty; static latitude/longitude numeric within the Bot API ranges) to [TemplateEngine.\_validateVenueItems()](./gramstax.templateengine._validatevenueitems.md)<!-- -->. `{{}}` / `{~ ~}` values skip the static numeric check — dynamic coordinates are range-checked at runtime on the compiled strings. Returns `valid: false` with per-line errors instead of throwing, so callers can aggregate across blocks.
